mapper.select: SELECT NVL(SUM(remain_alert), 0) AS remainAlert, -- 滞留预警 NVL(SUM(appointment_alert), 0) AS appointmentAlert, -- 预约预警 NVL(SUM(early_leave), 0) AS earlyLeave -- 早退人数 FROM TR_OUTP_ALT_OV WHERE stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}

SELECT doctor_name AS doctorName, -- 医生姓名 dept_name AS deptName, -- 科室名称 NVL(SUM(remain_alert), 0) AS remainAlert, -- 滞留预警 NVL(SUM(appointment_alert), 0) AS appointmentAlert, -- 预约预警 NVL(SUM(early_leave), 0) AS earlyLeave -- 早退人数 FROM TR_OUTP_ALT_OV WHERE stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND doctor_name IS NOT NULL
AND dept_code = #{deptCode}
AND dept_name LIKE '%' || #{deptName} || '%'
GROUP BY doctor_name, dept_name ORDER BY remainAlert DESC

SELECT dept_name AS deptName, -- 科室名称 doctor_name AS doctorName, -- 医生姓名 stat_date AS statDate, -- 统计日期 clinic_period AS clinicPeriod, -- 出诊时段 his_logout_time AS hisLogoutTime, -- HIS退出时间 NVL(remain_alert, 0) AS remainAlert, -- 滞留预警 NVL(appointment_alert, 0) AS appointmentAlert, -- 预约预警 NVL(early_leave, 0) AS earlyLeave -- 早退人数 FROM TR_OUTP_ALT_OV WHERE stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND NVL(early_leave, 0) > 0
AND dept_code = #{deptCode}
AND dept_name LIKE '%' || #{deptName} || '%'
AND doctor_name LIKE '%' || #{doctorName} || '%'
AND clinic_period LIKE '%' || #{clinicPeriod} || '%'
ORDER BY stat_date DESC, dept_name, doctor_name
